changelog:
- Initial release of the "find-skills" skill.
- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their needs or questions.
- Provides guidance on using the Skills CLI for searching, installing, and updating skills.
- Offers suggestions and installation commands for relevant skills found in the open agent skills ecosystem.
- Includes tips for effective skill searches and handling cases where no matching skills are found.
summary: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...
